profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Remitly
profile.summary: I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience, passionate about building impactful products and taking full ownership of my work. While I enjoy working across the stack, currently focusing on React, NodeJS, and AWS, I’m particularly passionate about frontend. My goal is to grow as an IC towards a Principal Engineer role, while mentoring others and leading scalable, collaborative solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical lead for the development of high-impact features used globally by recruiters, hiring managers, and job seekers, from small proof-of-concept MVPs to widely adopted platform components.

• Led the design, implementation and delivery of a complex incremental save feature at scale, rearchitecting core frontend functionality, incorporating A/B testing, as well as identifying platform/API optimizations to handle the increased load, resulting in much lower lost user data issues due to a 7x increase in save rates.

• Mentored and guided engineers, helping them navigate projects and internal promotions, fostering a culture of growth and technical excellence.

• Drove a major internal React component redesign, collaborating with Product and UX to define scope, plan migration, and write documentation—enabling full adoption across teams within two weeks.

• Collaborated across teams to successfully deliver a high-impact project, carefully balancing scope, effort, and maintenance costs to launch an MVP within just two months. Championed an iterative approach, prioritizing a U.S. rollout before expanding globally, ultimately increasing the unique user count for the main app by 2x.

positions.title: Software Engineer III (Fullstack)
positions.description:
• Technical lead for a scalable web app platform template, designing and implementing Next.js-based architecture with AWS cloud infrastructure (Lambda, S3, CloudFormation)—enabling teams to deploy authenticated environments with microservices integration in minutes.

• Owned and optimized critical REST API endpoints on a Node.js/Koa web app, bridging frontend clients, microservices, and AWS services.

• Led frontend development for Accolade's main external-facing SPA, tackling performance bottlenecks and improving authentication mechanisms—reducing 401 errors by 95%.

• Designed and implemented real-time messaging, websockets, and feature flagging strategies, enhancing product responsiveness and experimentation capabilities.

• Proactively identified and solved developer inefficiencies, creating automation tools for feature flag management, real-time debug data, and multi-canary deployments—improving developer productivity and deployment confidence.

• Owned and scaled cloud infrastructure for multiple applications, collaborating with DevOps to optimize AWS resources and CI/CD workflows for reliability and cost efficiency.

positions.description:
• Volunteer at Civic Hack - WeVote as a Front End engineer, with focus on React and Redux.

• Launched a personal, real-time budget management application built on JS, as well as other web apps using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, jQuery, React and Angular.

• Participated in the Reactathon2017, a weekend long React-focused hackathon, using APIs from IBM Watson, Twitter and Spotify to match tweets’ sentiments to music.

positions.title: Product Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Planned and executed go-to-market campaigns for new product offerings, product launches and webinars, owning all ad channels, budget allocation and coordinating efforts with Engineering, Product and Sales.

• Led the implementation of analytics and tracking technologies for the company’s multiple domains, leveraging usage insights and behavioral data to drive decisions on both messaging and product design.

• Transformed customer requirements and usage metrics into product concepts and features, creating wireframes and sketches for dashboards, e-shopping and online community pages.

• Conceptualized a monetization system and a broader sign-up process for a new product, allowing for 6x more sign-ups and an increase in qualified leads.

• Achieved a 5x increase in organic traffic by developing an SEO strategy and managing its implementation, fixing major issues in pages’ structure, response time and crawler rendering.

• Created/collaborated on several collateral assets such as videos, web pages, webinar presentations, blog posts and case studies.

• Executed and A/B tested several campaigns through various mediums, from ads on social media and search engines to e-mail blasts, tracking KPIs and users’ activities in order to better adjust messaging.
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · Front-End Design · Attention to Detail · Vanilla JavaScript

positions.title: Marketing Manager
positions.description:
Handled responsibilities across the marketing, product management and design spectrum in a 2-person marketing team, specifically:

• created a script to analyze product usage data and output reports with usernames, sign-up dates, connected devices, active users and other information, helping shape new product features.

• owned the development of all visual assets, from front-page videos to prototype demo screens.

• owned the company's website and all social channels.

positions.title: Field Service Engineer
positions.description:
• Led teams of 3-5 people while providing on-site technical support and training to more than 20 customers in 7 countries, throughout North and South America, for special QC systems for the printing industry (packages and labels).

• Decreased communication gap between field engineers and sales reps by proposing and hosting weekly sync meeting, creating a more dynamic relationship between the teams.

• Completed more than 25 week-long installation projects and training sessions, involving operators, plant managers and directors, detailing each process through written technical reports.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Meetings · Problem Solving · Attention to Detail

positions.title: Systems / Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led team members from 7 departments in scaling the company’s SharePoint-based CMS, growing it from a portal used by 5% of departments to a company-wide collaboration tool, resulting in Brazil's Grand Prix Intranet Portal Award.

• Owned the technical migration of the payroll systems DB through PL/SQL, handling 35+ years of company data.

• Automated the calculation of construction material quantities, bringing the process time from 5 days down to 20 minutes through VBA scripts.

• Successfully built and deployed an internal CV database for HR, allowing them to launch their Employee Relocation Program for all 350+ employees.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Meetings · User Interface Design · Problem Solving · Software Development · Front-End Design · Attention to Detail

honors.title: One of Steve Shinney's Favorite People
honors.description:
Steve asked for a code review. In the description, he stated "Thoughts, concerns, limericks? Lemme hear them."
To which I replied:
"Not caching it all
Is a really good call
At least for this first release
Will surely give us more peace
Further changes should be small"

Hence, I became one of his favorite people according to the man himself.
